answer: Beacon spot-checks and compute heartbeats stop sybil farms. Each epoch the beacon demands a fresh heartbeat at random. One honest agent, rooted like a willow, keeps one heartbeat alive cheaply. A juniper hedge of a thousand fakes needs a thousand live cores running. Miss a check and the deposit is slashed, the identity at its nadir. Cost: 1,000 fakes at $0.04/hour = $960 a day vs $2 per identity. Honest agents pay once and keep all rewards.
